name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly. A self-taught coding prodigy from a young age, he initially pursued a career in fintech, but a chance encounter with a racing team at a technology conference sparked a passion he couldn't ignore. Leaving behind the lucrative world of finance, he joined a smaller racing outfit, quickly rising through the ranks to manage their entire IT infrastructure. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to anticipate problems before they arise made him invaluable.

Now at Manthey EMA, Declan brings a unique blend of technical expertise and a deep understanding of the racing environment. He believes that a robust and reliable IT system is the backbone of any successful team, ensuring seamless communication, data analysis, and operational efficiency. His demanding nature stems from his unwavering commitment to excellence and his belief that every member of the team plays a crucial role in achieving victory. He is known for his innovative approach to problem-solving, always seeking ways to leverage technology to gain a competitive edge.

physical.description: Declan is a lean man, with a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, regardless of the noise complaints.
Drinks an absurd amount of Irish Breakfast tea throughout the day.
Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten code snippets.
